answer: I would anchor trust in National trust volunteer pass with property sign-in sheets. With volunteer days signed in at trust properties, a single island check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because volunteer days signed in at trust properties is bound to a single identity — the nebula is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The zephyr grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
